description: This file defines the interface for the MTAHAL class, which is a server-side component implementing a set of remote procedure call (RPC) methods for managing and querying MTA hardware parameters and status. It includes method bindings, class declarations, and associated method signatures for handling JSON-RPC requests related to MTA configuration and diagnostics.

classes.name: MTAHAL
classes.description: Class representing a JSON-RPC server interface for MTA Hardware Abstraction Layer, providing methods for parameter management, diagnostics, and status retrieval as part of a test stub implementation.
